title: Create your first course
behavior: A name is required. No real course, assignment or provider is preloaded.
recovery: Course creation failure preserves the typed name and offers Retry. Cancel returns to empty home.

title: Synthetic course · demo only
behavior: Active / Archived / Trash filters. Create course; rename; edit description; choose reusable modules; export course.
recovery: Archive removes a course from active navigation without deleting it. Restore returns it to Active. Export reports files, size, progress, failure and destination.

title: Delete Synthetic course?
behavior: Show material, notes, activities and index counts. Offer recoverable trash where practical or permanent deletion. Backups are separate copies and remain.
recovery: Cancel is initially focused. Permanent deletion requires typed course name and explicit confirmation. Failed cleanup stays visible and retryable; do not claim success before completion.

title: Import into Synthetic course
behavior: Files, images, PDF, DOCX, DRM-free EPUB, pasted text or new note. Batch list shows each item, original preserved, extraction state, duplicate handling and cancel.
recovery: Invalid/corrupt/oversized item errors identify the item. Interrupted work offers safe retry. No silent overwrite of originals.

title: Sample passage · revision 2
behavior: Original opens on the left; editable extraction on the right. Source version, checksum and page/paragraph/region anchor remain visible. User-created notes have their own edit action.
recovery: Save correction creates a revision and marks search, embeddings and activities stale. Save failure retains edits; leave-with-unsaved-changes offers Keep editing / Discard. Narrow desktop uses labeled Original / Text tabs.

title: One item / Selection / Course / Portable backup
behavior: Choose original plus corrections and annotations. Show version, checksum manifest, size, destination and whether derived indexes are included. Credentials never included.
recovery: Export runs locally with progress/cancel. Partial export is not labeled complete. Retry preserves source data; unsupported format is explained.

title: Move 2 selected items to trash?
behavior: Preview originals, extracted text, notes and derived study/index data. Show recoverable period if supported; permanent deletion is a separate choice. Backups remain independent.
recovery: Deleted material immediately leaves retrieval/AI context. Cleanup interruption shows Pending cleanup. Restore rebuilds derivatives; permanent deletion cannot be undone.

title: No connected services
behavior: OpenAI / ChatGPT, xAI / Grok, Anthropic / Claude, Google / Gemini, and Add approved provider. Every card starts disconnected. OpenAI is optional and removable.
recovery: Add asks for a label and supported authentication method. API credentials use protected local storage; OAuth opens provider sign-in only when an official integration route exists.

title: API credential or supported account sign-in
behavior: OpenAI: API or documented app-server account route. Google: API or supported desktop OAuth. xAI and Anthropic: API; subscription OAuth unavailable until verified. No real credential field in this design gallery.
recovery: Pending sign-in includes Cancel. Test connection reports success/error without exposing credentials. Expired/revoked access asks to reconnect; unsupported route explains why. Do not imply that subscription pays API bills.

title: Synthetic connection · not live
behavior: Provider enabled toggle; independent Tutor, Research, Narration, Transcription, Realtime voice capability toggles; capability model/default selector. Local embeddings remain local.
recovery: Unsupported capabilities are labeled unavailable. Model, billing type, remaining allowance and optional hard usage ceiling shown before use. Unknown cost blocks paid use; no silent paid fallback.

title: Remove Synthetic connection?
behavior: Disable stops requests. Disconnect clears local credentials. Remove also deletes service settings/default assignments. Course files, notes, study history and saved research remain.
recovery: Warn that remote OAuth revocation may need network. Show local credential removal and remote revocation separately. Failure blocks use and offers Retry cleanup; never claim remote revocation offline.

title: No research sessions yet
behavior: Select course, provider and query. Private excerpts are off by default; preview exact selected context and categories before Send. Billing and provider are visible.
recovery: No provider/offline/limit/error state offers a remedy. Cancel preserves query and received evidence. No background research or automatic promotion into course requirements.

title: Synthetic claim · sample only
behavior: Claim links to source title, URL, publisher/author, retrieved date and exact excerpt. Uncertainty, conflicts and inaccessible sources appear alongside the claim.
recovery: Save selected evidence into course, edit notes, export or delete session. Provider changes require a new explicit choice; existing evidence retains original provenance even after provider removal.

title: Cloud service unavailable
behavior: Prepared reading, notes, search and saved audio remain local. New cloud responses need a connection. Sources/derivatives not prepared are honestly unavailable.
recovery: Service outage preserves unsaved edits and offers retry; invalid saved route returns Home with notice. Course changes never display another course’s draft.

title: No source selected
behavior: Source pane, user notes, study activity and optional audio have distinct headings. Resume last task with exact source/version/anchor. AI explanations remain labeled by provider.
recovery: No study facts or assignment rules invented. Accessible 2D controls remain available without voice or 3D. Source correction marks dependent activities stale rather than presenting them as current.
